user: And the FX spread if I pay in USD?
answer:
I couldn't find the specific spread for tier1 in our documentation, so I can't give you a percentage yet. Here is what I did find:

- A card payment in a currency other than your account currency (EUR) triggers a conversion at settlement, under the standard tier spread.
- The conversion is priced as: mid-market rate, then the tier spread (a percentage of the converted amount), then the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within your remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the allowance is used up, the full spread applies.

If you tell me the USD amount you're considering, I can run a full FX quote showing the mid rate, spread, allowance, and final EUR amount.

fragments.text:
Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Currency conversion operations
## When a conversion happens
A conversion happens when the payment currency differs from the currency of the
account being debited. The conversion is applied at settlement, not at
authorisation.

Cards
## Foreign use
A card used abroad in a currency other than the account currency triggers a
conversion at settlement under the standard tier spread.
